The '''Hune sector''' was a [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] near [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], north of [[Nixor/Legends|Nixor]].<ref name="teaoc" /> The region was explored by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] between [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]] and [[15,000 BBY/Legends|15,000 BBY]]&mdash;during the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]]&mdash;and subsequently annexed. The sector was absorbed by the expanding [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] circa [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], but the Republic won control back by [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]. After a period of [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] and Republic rule, the Hutts gained control once again by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], losing control during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]]. By [[137 ABY]], the sector was controlled by [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]].<ref name="tea" />
